mutants.name: leading_zero_arrangements
mutants.desc: counts all n!/prod(c!) arrangements of each good multiset, forgetting to exclude leading zeros

mutants.name: middle_digit_nonzero
mutants.desc: builds palindromes from first-half digits then a middle digit in 1..9 (middle 0 skipped) for odd n

mutants.name: no_dedup
mutants.desc: sums arrangement counts per k-palindrome without deduplicating digit multisets

mutants.name: palindrome_leading_zero
mutants.desc: enumerates palindrome halves including a leading 0 (palindrome itself may start with 0)

mutants.name: wrong_zero_subtraction
mutants.desc: leading-zero correction uses (n-1)!/prod(c!) without decrementing the zero count
